intentional_divergences: Replace sirilpy image access, selection statistics, progress and logging, and the astropy FITS files the dialog reads and writes, with AfterNight SDK image handles, open views, metadata and logging.
Replace the dialog's Estimate, Generate and Blend buttons with two processes: Continuum Subtraction (estimate or set c, then subtract, on the emission image) and Continuum Blend (on the RGB image).
Take the estimation region from a painted manual mask instead of a Siril selection rectangle; without one the whole image is used, as upstream does.
Estimate c on every preview and Apply while Estimate c Automatically is on, logging it, since the SDK has no way for a run to move the c slider.
Fall back to the fine scan's best factor, clipped to [0, 1], when the smooth-V fit fails or its starting point is infeasible, where upstream ends the estimate with an error.
Read the continuum from an open mono view, and blend into an open RGB view, instead of separate R, G, B and line files; images are compared in [0, 1], integers divided by their type's maximum.
Express the dialog's per-line channel choice as a Channels preset (Ha into red, SII into green, OIII into blue) or custom weights.
Drop the matplotlib plot of the fit.
